## Current Role

**Nordic Operations Manager — Nordcloud, an IBM Company** (October 2025 – Present)

Sole operational lead for IBM's 5 Nordic offices: Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Copenhagen, and Oslo. Full P&L accountability including budget forecasting, cost-reduction initiatives, vendor contract negotiations, and sustainability-aligned procurement strategy. Central bridge between Nordic C-suite, IBM global management, and external suppliers across a multi-country enterprise footprint.

## Career History

**Communications & Operations Lead — DigiNytt** (January – October 2025)
Led communications, operations, and administration for a sustainability-focused digital media platform. Produced editorial content on smart water infrastructure and climate technology.

**Advocacy & Institutional Fundraising — The Kvinna till Kvinna Foundation** (January – June 2024)
Developed policy proposals on gender equality and climate finance. Coordinated multi-stakeholder international workshops. Managed institutional grant applications for programmes supporting women in conflict zones.

**EU Project Manager — BALTEUS spol. s.r.o.** (December 2021 – September 2023)
Managed EU structural-fund projects for an industrial circular economy company processing 300+ tonnes of non-recyclable plastics daily. Secured EU funding and authored grant proposals aligned with circular economy policy frameworks.

**Parliamentary Trainee — European Parliament** (August 2020 – January 2021)
Competitive Schuman Traineeship at the Committees on Agriculture, Rural Development, and International Trade in Brussels. Contributed legislative analysis on Farm to Fork Strategy, EU circular economy regulation, and international trade. One of fewer than 300 trainees selected EU-wide per intake.
